issue.title: Per-row successor-offer destination override in Bob Mac Capture and a destination grammar for bob capture --pull-in

task_type_fields.proposal: Let a Successor Offer pick choose its Pomodoro destination outside Obsidian, as Obsidian already does with the successor picker's Ctrl+Shift+Enter (docs/task-dependencies.md §12.13, bob-cli-7c.6). In bob capture, extend -p/--pull-in PICKS with a per-pick destination spelling: an existing open entry by name/line, or a new named entry. The value is validated against the staged day text with the same write-free teaching errors as stale picks. In Bob Mac Capture, add a retarget key in the in-panel pull-in choice step (CapturePullInChoice.swift) that lists today's open entries plus 'new…', shows '→ NAME' on the row, and submits the destination through the new grammar. offer.destination is already in the capture JSON, so bob stays the sole write authority (decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-7c epic (plan:202610/successor_offers.md, 'Out of scope (deferred follow-ups)') shipped the override only in Obsidian and explicitly deferred the Mac override and the CLI destination grammar. Proposed by bob-cli-7c.8 note #1; filed by the bob-cli-7c land agent.

issue.creation_reason: plan:202610/successor_offers.md deferred per-row destination overrides outside Obsidian. bob-cli-7c.8 proposed tracking them, and no existing bead does.

payload.description: Successor Offers epic that shipped the offer/pick contract and the Obsidian-only destination override this extends
